text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis: \"not be reliable enough and will be dangerous, ... and ... very expensive\"","quality":"argument focus","description":"The essay states a clear position and organizes the body around several distinct reasons for that position."},{"evidence":"separate body paragraphs on danger, blame, and cost","quality":"organization","description":"The essay develops its case in a more structured way, with each paragraph advancing a different claim."},{"evidence":"\"technology malfunctions all the time\"; \"who is to blame?\"; \"Is it really worth all the money?\"","quality":"claim development","description":"The reasons are expanded with explanation and follow-up questions rather than only asserted."},{"evidence":"\"There will need to be all new laws to avoid conflicts of who is to blame\"","quality":"use of source evidence","description":"The essay integrates specific details from the article to support its argument instead of relying mainly on opinion."},{"evidence":"rhetorical questions and scenario of a crash with spouse and child","quality":"persuasive elaboration","description":"The writing uses a more vivid hypothetical example and rhetorical framing to make the argument more convincing."}]}
